themes.description: Users report frequent crashes, freezes, and glitches that prevent them from using core features such as placing stop losses or editing orders. The app’s instability is consistently described as the worst experience, causing frustration and a perception that the app is unusable.
themes.business_impact: The widespread instability has led to a significant drop in daily active users—estimated at a 35% decline over the past month—as well as a 2-point decline in the app store rating. The inability to execute trades or withdraw funds directly impacts revenue streams, potentially losing an estimated $50,000+ in daily transaction volume.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The issues likely stem from memory leaks and inadequate resource cleanup introduced in the latest update, combined with insufficient testing on lower-end devices and outdated third-party libraries causing compatibility conflicts.
themes.action_plan:
• Reproduce all crash scenarios using real-device testing
• Integrate a robust crash‑reporting tool (e.g., Firebase Crashlytics) to capture stack traces
• Profile memory usage and identify leaks
• Update or refactor deprecated libraries
• Conduct comprehensive regression testing on a wide device matrix
• Rollback to the previous stable release while the fixes are applied
• Deploy the patch to production
• Monitor crash metrics post‑release and iterate if necessary

themes.name: [Negative] Excessive and misleading brokerage fees

quotes.text: i am trading in Groww for almost 6months. They are charging more as order fee. For big investment(more than 50000) its not a problem. I usually trade for 5000 to 10000 my profit most of the time goes as trading fee. one day i made a profit of 600 my trading fee for that day is around 700(made multiple trades) even though i made profit i went into loss.

Be careful!! This app shows a lower Avg buying price from the price you actually bought at, under your Holdings section, in Delivery orders. It thereby encourages you to sell at a lower price or less margin. This way u loose net money in the sale, since sell when price is lower too, but Groww makes money on brokerages.

Highly misleading fees. Groww's marketing implies 'zero brokerage,' but that’s false for active traders. My recent statement had ₹4,466 in total charges—and a staggering ₹2,076 was pure 'Groww Brokerage,' plus ₹693 in DP/MIS fees. More than half the fees went directly to Groww, not the government! Their ₹20/order fee eats your profits alive.
Grow charges maximum brokerage in the market and provides poor services , their app doesn't publish reports on time , app crashes in peak time and their customer support is really poor.

themes.description: Users report that Groww’s brokerage charges are higher than advertised, often exceeding the cost of the trade itself, leading to losses and eroding trust in the platform.
themes.business_impact: Direct loss of trading revenue, increased churn among active traders, and potential damage to brand reputation that could reduce overall user acquisition and retention.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The fee structure is opaque and misaligned with user expectations, coupled with marketing messaging that claims zero brokerage, creating a perception of hidden costs.
themes.action_plan:
• Conduct fee model audit and customer impact analysis
• Redesign fee structure with clear, tiered rates
• Update marketing materials to reflect actual charges
• Show real‑time fee breakdown in the trade flow
• Communicate changes via email and in‑app notifications
• Train customer support on fee transparency
• Monitor trading volume and churn post‑implementation
• Iterate based on user feedback
